_readme: Real Indian currency photographs for the Market Day numeracy game. Indian banknote and coin DESIGNS are the copyright of the Reserve Bank of India / Government of India. The licenses recorded below apply to the IMAGE FILES as tagged on Wikimedia Commons, not to the underlying currency designs. See public/content/currency/ATTRIBUTION.md before shipping commercially.
